parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The query end time. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. Example: 1761926399999.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ProductProgramList
parameters.description: The list of product codes to query. For specific values, refer to the productCode under the corresponding ProductType.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description:
The product type. Valid values:
- **FINANCE_VERIFY**: Finance-grade ID Verification.
- **SMART_VERIFY**: Enhanced ID Verification (discontinued).
- **FACE_VERIFY**: ID Verification (discontinued).

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The query start time. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. Example: 1743436800000.

parameters.name: StatisticsType
parameters.description:
The statistics dimension. Valid values:
- **day**: daily.
- **month**: monthly.
